The 27th Fangoria Chainsaw Awards will honor the best horror films that were released between July 2024 and June 2025. The nominees were announced on July 9, 2025. The ceremony will be livestreamed on Shudder in October 2025.
Among the nominees, Sinners and The Substance led with ten nominations each.
